ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Pyrelands Mechanics
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
PYRELANDS_MECHANICS_1 — the igniter kit the Pyrelands sheet (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_pyrelands.md) and the wave-2 commission brief (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/creatures/RUT_ruled_commissions_wave2.md §§7-8) owe.
PYRELANDS_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 §6 (2026-09-25) absorbed the franchise-free two-thirds of this kit — the burn-line, its arson-debt intelligence, the fire-hawk's twig and the furnace-beast's thermal circuit — into mandrake.rm.pyrelands, which now REQUIRES this mod is loaded after. What remains here names the Deep Desert Tribes, a campaign faction, and cannot move to that franchise-free tier:
1. The Tribes answer the burn. A flame-harvest party walks in to work a live burn-line (mandrake.rm.pyrelands' MapComponent_BurnLine, read across the mod boundary); an unplanned burn the colony is responsible for is answered by arson-justice — a short, furious raid.
2. The Deep Tribes' fire rite. Some of the RM_Pyrelands fire clock's scheduled burns arrive with people attached instead: a small Deep Tribes party walks in off the sand, lights the line itself, works the black behind the front for scorch-fruit, and leaves with what it took. The ruling behind it — "they are FIRE HARVESTERS, and they are the Deep Tribes … the Pyre burns with or without them" — is why it is a fraction of the clock and never the whole of it. Reached through RimMandrake.Pyrelands.PyrelandsFireRiteHook, a plugin hook this mod fills in — mandrake.rm.pyrelands never depends on this mod existing.
